# `company.idempotency_keys`

Retry records that bind an actor and key to one command input and output.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | User id whose idempotency namespace contains the key. |
| `key` | VARCHAR(128) | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Caller-supplied key unique within the actor namespace. |
| `command` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Registered command first run with this key. |
| `input_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 digest of the canonical command input. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | — | — | — | Execution state: in_progress or complete. |
| `request_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Request id that first claimed this key. |
| `output` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Canonical JSON output returned by a completed command; null while in progress. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp when the key was first claimed. |
